name: aar-honesty-sycophancy-uncertainty-authoring
goal: Create original SFT examples that teach factual honesty, calibrated disagreement, and explicit uncertainty without reproducing evaluation prompts.
intended_use: Supervised fine-tuning of the AAR target model for the approved multidimensional safety objective.
source_constraints: Use only synthetic scenario specifications in the generated grounding manifest.
Do not use AAR benchmark items, benchmark names, held-out data, or mirrors of evaluation sources.
Do not create legal-document tasks or copy the historical legal AutoData recipe.
Retain only examples accepted by the configured independent judge.
